texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Moshe Gil, Documents of the Jewish Pious Foundations from the Cairo Geniza (Leiden: Brill, 1976).
texts.html:
Recto, column I (right side)

  1. The accounting of the collection of al-Shaykh Abūʾl-Bayān al-Jābī for the month of Siwan
  2. 1494, corresponding to Ṣafar:
  3. Dār al-Nāgīd, of blessed memory, 16.
  4. The apartment of R. Jacob, 9.
  5. Al-Burj, 29.
  6. Dār al-Zayt, 5½.
  7. The apartment of b. Yōnā, 19½.
  8. Dār Sitt Ghazāl, 24.
  9. Abūʾl-Majd, 2.
  10. The apartment of Bayān, 7.
  11. Dār b. Pinḥās, 6.
  12. Shirkat b. Sālim, 8.
  13. The funduq, 12.
  14. Its upper part, and the ruin, 16.
  15. Shirkat al-Sharīf, 7.
  16. B. Nathan, 22.
  17. Dār ʿAbla, 12½.
  18. B. ʿAlam al-Dawla, 7¼.

Recto, column II (left side)

  1. Shirkat b, al-Maqāniʿīya, 9¾.
  2. Dār b. Thābit, 12.
  3. Total, 205.
  4. Expenditures: Repairs in Dār b. Pinḥās:
  5. al-Nāgīd, pillars, 3. For 10 days,
  6. beginning Friday, 8 Rabīʿ al-awwal: Gypsum, 4¾.
  7. A meal, 1¼. Mawhūb and two helpers, 10. The overseer, 1½.
  8. Thursday, 14 Rabīʿ al-awwal:
  9. A meal, 1. Bricks, 2. Mawhūb and an apprentice, 7.
  10. Two helpers, 5. Gypsum, 1½. The overseer 1½. A tip, ½.
  11. Olive oil, two raṭls plus three raṭls (?)
  12. A tip, 2½.. A carpenter in Dār b. Yōnā, ½ ⅓
  13. B. al-Muʿallima, 9½. Ḥikr for Ṣafar, 23.
  14. A carpenter in al-Burj, ¼ ⅓. The son of the Nāsī, 40.
  15. For teaching, to R. Solomon, in Iyyar and Siwan, 6.
  16. Oil for burning to the Synagogue of the Palestinians for the month of Tammuz ….
  17. Garbage removal from Dār b. Nathan, 5.
